papers.title: Local Homological Mirror Symmetry
papers.abstract: Local mirror symmetry, originated from the work of Chiang-Klemm-Yau-Zaslow arXiv:9903053, indicated a potential relation between mirrors to a vector bundle and mirrors to its zero section. In this paper, we constructed a homological mirror to these local varieties and proved the corresponding Homological Mirror Symmetry statement. As an application, we constructed infinite families of exotic Weinstein sectors as mirrors to Hirzebruch surfaces.

papers.title: Functors from Lagrangian correspondences for wrapped sheaf categories
papers.abstract: We consider the category of sheaves on a manifold with microsupport in a singular conic Lagrangian, and more generally microsheaves on the Lagrangian skeleton of a Weinstein manifold with stop, which are equivalent to ind-completions of partially wrapped Fukaya categories. Compact objects in these categories are obtained as wrappings of constructible sheaves with perfect stalks; they correspond to objects built from exact Lagrangians in finitely many steps. We give a microlocal criterion on constructible (micro)sheaves with perfect (micro)stalks which guarantees that the corresponding wrapped sheaves induce integral kernels that preserve compact objects of these categories. This generalizes a result of Gao on Lagrangian correspondences between fully wrapped Fukaya categories.

papers.title: The symplectic leaves of the affine Poisson $C^\infty$-scheme associated with a singular subalgebroid
papers.abstract: Every singular subalgebroid, and in particular every singular foliation $\mathscr{G}$, determines a universal Poisson $C^\infty$-scheme $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$, which is the analogue of the linear Poisson structure on the dual of a Lie algebroid. We show that the underlying space $X_{\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G})}$ of $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$ decomposes as a disjoint union of symplectic manifolds. Furthermore, we extend the Helffer-Nourrigat cone to a singular subalgebroid and show that it is an embedded Poisson $C^\infty$-subscheme of $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$.

papers.title: Shifted Lagrangian geometry of curves in Radko surfaces
papers.abstract: We describe the shifted Lagrangian geometry of curves in Radko surfaces, through their global integrations and their homotopy Poisson algebras. We construct the adjoint symplectic groupoid of the surface explicitly, show that admissible curves integrate to embedded Lagrangian subgroupoids, which are 1-shifted Lagrangians, and characterize when their shifted intersections are clean. For a component of the degeneracy locus, a canonical Hamiltonian flow on its shifted self-intersection recovers the modular period. On the infinitesimal side, the homotopy Poisson algebra of a connected admissible curve not contained in the degeneracy locus is $L_\infty$-isomorphic to its underlying cochain complex, and its $L_\infty$-isomorphism class is determined by the total contact multiplicity. The brackets of arity at least two can be removed by a change of tubular neighbourhood exactly when all contacts are transverse. At tangential contacts, the binary bracket retains the modular vector field. We establish this distinction using a general characterization of the $L_\infty$-isomorphisms induced by changes of tubular neighbourhood, valid for arbitrary coisotropic submanifolds.

papers.title: Worldsheet skeins and block decomposition of quivers
papers.abstract: Following the knot-quiver correspondence, we investigate quiver counterparts of the HOMFLYPT skein relations by interpreting link invariants in terms of holomorphic worldsheets and their multicover contributions. Extending this framework to more general worldsheet geometries, we conjecture that, up to quiver equivalence, the adjacency matrix of the quiver associated with any link in a skein triple admits a block decomposition whose diagonal blocks are quiver adjacency matrices associated with the other two links. We verify this conjecture in numerous examples.

papers.title: Holomorphic planes in $M\times \mathbb{T}^2$ from weakly exact Lagrangians in $M$
papers.abstract: Let $(M,\omega_M)$ be closed symplectic manifold containing a closed Lagrangian submanifold $L$ with $\omega_M$ vanishing on $\pi_2(M,L)$. We prove that there is a nonconstant $J$-holomorphic plane $u:\mathbb{C}\rightarrow M\times \mathbb{T}^2$ for any almost complex structure $ J$ on $M\times \mathbb{T}^2$ tamed by $\omega_M\oplus\omega_{\text{std}}$.

papers.title: P-curvature from a TQFT viewpoint
papers.abstract: This paper is motivated by the recent discovery, in symplectic topology, of a relation (partly proved, partly conjectural) between quantum connection and quantum Steenrod operations. We introduce an abstract TQFT framework, based on certain features of the definition of deformed symplectic cohomology, in which such a relation holds generally.

papers.title: Effective Gromov-Witten computations for GKM spaces and a semisimple application
papers.abstract: We report a major update to our original software GKMtools and record multiple improvements in the computation of Gromov--Witten invariants of GKM spaces. This includes a refined divisor equation that reduces the complexity from exponential to linear in the number of marked points, three tricks to accelerate the computation of curve class relations in the GKM graph, and an implementation of Mihalcea's algorithm for homogeneous varieties using the equivariant quantum Chevalley formula. As an application, we prove that the small quantum cohomology of the type $E$ generalized Grassmannians $E_7/P_2,E_7/P_4,E_7/P_5,E_8/P_6$ is generically semisimple. These are precisely the remaining exceptional Grassmannians for which generic semisimplicity of small quantum cohomology was still unknown.

papers.title: Morse flow categories as exit path categories
papers.abstract: We prove that the topological flow category $\mathcal{M}$ arising from a Morse-Smale pair $(f,\xi)$ on a smooth closed manifold $X$ is equivalent, as an $\infty$-category, to Lurie's $\infty$-category $\mathrm{Sing}_A(X)$ of exit paths in $X$ with respect to the stratification by the stable manifolds of $\xi$. The objects of $\mathcal{M}$ are the critical points of $f$, and for every pair of critical points, the space of morphisms of $\mathcal{M}$ between these is the space of possibly broken trajectories of $\xi$ connecting them; it can be identified up to homotopy with the space of unbroken ones. The latter maps naturally to the space of exit paths connecting these critical points; we prove this map to be a weak homotopy equivalence. Then, we combine these ingredients with several others to construct a zigzag of equivalences between the homotopy coherent nerve of $\mathcal{M}$, denoted $\mathcal{N}(\mathcal{M})$, and $\mathrm{Sing}_A(X)$. The $n$-simplices of $\mathcal{N}(\mathcal{M})$ are homotopy coherent diagrams of $n$ composable morphisms of $\mathcal{M}$; we introduce the notion of unbroken diagram, yielding an $\infty$-subcategory of $\mathcal{N}(\mathcal{M})$, which we refer to as the flow coherent nerve of $\mathcal{M}$. The simplices of the latter give rise to stratified maps out of a family of stratified cubes, into $X$. We organize this family into a functor from the category of finite ordered sequences of critical points, to the category of $A$-stratified topological spaces, and we prove a comparison result with the usual stratified geometric realization functor. We finally use a theorem of Tanaka that associates a functor to a semi-simplicial map between $\infty$-categories that satisfies certain conditions. Our theorem has implications regarding constructible sheaves and the description of homotopy types in terms of flow categories.

papers.title: Algebra of the Infrared with Elliptic Curve-Valued Potential
papers.abstract: We study an extension of the algebra of the infrared to curve--valued potentials, focusing on the elliptic curve case. Given a finite configuration of points on an elliptic curve, we construct associated \(L_\infty\)-algebra. Adding an extra point produces a directed \(A_\infty\)-algebra and an \(L_\infty\)-morphism to their directed Hochschild deformation complexes. Maurer--Cartan elements of the \(L_\infty\)-algebra determine \(A_\infty\)-deformations of the directed algebra. We formulate a conjectural comparison between Maurer--Cartan deformations of the directed algebra and the directed Fukaya--Seidel category associated to compatible finite collections of thimbles.

papers.title: Moment Lagrangians, unobstructedness and symplectic groupoids
papers.abstract: Moment Lagrangian $L_\mu$ is a Lagrangian in $T^*G^- \times Y^- \times Y$ associated to a Hamiltonian $G$-space $Y$ with a moment map $\mu$. In this paper, we prove that $L_\mu$ is tautologically unobstructed under mild assumptions on $Y$. As a key ingredient in the proof, we constructed a new symplectic groupoid structure on $T^*G^- \times Y^- \times Y$ over $G\times Y$ for which $L_\mu$ is simultaneously the unit and the fixed locus of the inversion, which might be of independent interest.
